title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of 50 Solar-System bodies. Four blinded evidence batches now cover the full planet/dwarf/satellite stratum plus five spacecraft/sample-return small-body anchors, with 157/300 evidence states coded and the composition ontology expanded to distinguish hydrated carbonaceous rubble piles from rock-ice worlds.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C022 froze the sample, raw-variable architecture, evidence protocol and anti-circularity ladder before analysis. Evidence v0.5 adds Vesta, Eros, Bennu, Ryugu and Itokawa using mission/returned-sample evidence and adds CARBONACEOUS_HYDRATED before encoding Bennu/Ryugu. Current-object ocean state remains separated from ancient parent-body aqueous alteration. No QCA calibration or solution inspection has occurred.

tables.status: case frame + physical + orbit + derived + evidence v0.5
